descriptions.IOS:
Fin is a terminal agent you can talk to. It connects to your computers, reads what is on their screens, and gets work done — by voice or by text — from your iPhone or iPad.

SSH TERMINALS, DIRECT OR THROUGH THE RELAY
• A real terminal: tmux-friendly reconnects, a dedicated key row, custom themes, and an instant resume that has your session on screen when you reopen the app
• Connect over SSH straight to your server, or through Fin's relay, which carries the same terminal over HTTPS for computers behind a firewall or on a network where you can't open a port. Nothing to forward, no VPN
• SSH keys import from Files or iCloud and are held in the Keychain

REMOTE DESKTOP AND REMOTE BROWSER
• Watch and control a computer's screen from your phone or iPad: tap, scroll, type, and use modifier keys
• Or open just the browser your agent is driving, so you can sign in or approve a two-factor prompt yourself and hand it back
• Each session opens behind Face ID or your passcode, and each computer opts in on its own

A PERSISTENT AGENT, BY VOICE OR TEXT
• Ask by voice: "Ask Fin whether the overnight build finished" — through Siri, or by dictating in the app. Fin reads the terminal, answers in a sentence, and offers the next step
• It keeps working after you put the phone down: it watches long tasks, replies when there is a result, and only interrupts you when a decision needs a human
• Run it where you want: Apple's on-device intelligence, Fin's cloud, or any model server you host yourself that speaks the standard chat-completions API (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM)
• Manual mode holds every command for your approval, and a destructive-command guard is always on
• It remembers what you teach it, and every run, tool call, and approval is in a trace you can read

FILES AND CLIPBOARD
• A clipboard manager built for terminal work, and Markdown runbooks that live beside your sessions

FIN PRO
Try everything free for 14 days. After the trial, Fin Pro is an annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Remote Desktop and Remote Browser need Fin's small background service on the computer you want to reach (macOS, with Screen Recording and Accessibility permission for the desktop).

descriptions.TV_OS:
Fin is a terminal agent you can talk to — and on Apple TV, the terminal itself goes on the big screen.

The servers you add in Fin on iPhone, iPad, or Mac appear here automatically through your own iCloud account. Pick one, connect, and watch the session on the largest display in the house.

ON APPLE TV
• Your server list, synced privately through your own iCloud
• A real terminal rendered for the big screen, so long-running output stays readable from across the room
• Agent mode: watch your persistent agent work — what it read, what it typed, and what it is waiting on
• Pair a Bluetooth keyboard, or use Fin on your iPhone or iPad as the keyboard for what is on screen

THE REST OF FIN
On iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro, Fin adds SSH through Fin's relay over HTTPS, Remote Desktop and Remote Browser, and voice: ask Siri to check on a build or run a task, and the agent — on-device, in Fin's cloud, or on a model server you host — does the work and tells you when it is done.
